method: Searched provider newsrooms, API model pages, changelogs and Hugging Face org listings (via the HF API) for each named provider, then read model cards. 'Notable' = a provider's current flagship and current small/efficient general-purpose LLM or multimodal assistant, plus recently superseded/deprecated models referenced by the 2026-09-01..10-16 release log and the benchmark's 10 local Ollama builds. Specialised models (image, video, speech, embeddings, time-series, cyber-only) are excluded. Primary sources preferred; 'secondary' marks press/aggregator sources used only where no primary page could be fetched. Fields that could not be verified are null. contextWindowTokens: exact figure where the source gives one; where a source states 'NK' it is recorded as N*1024 (e.g. 128K = 131072, 256K = 262144), and '1M' as 1000000 unless the source gives 1,048,576. access: 'both' = open weights or a consumer app alongside an API, as verified. Not a rating or assessment.
